papers.title: CADWorld: Computer-Use Benchmark for Long-Horizon Computer-Aided Design
papers.summary: Computer-use agents are increasingly evaluated in realistic desktop environments, but existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of professional engineering workflows whose outputs are persistent, structured artifacts.
